observations.behavior: Adds a review-step-only audience check for recipients missing an email property, and a banner to display the missing recipient count.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks recipient email availability before sending; this could prevent sending to addresses without a configured email property, or warn users of potential delivery failure.

observations.behavior: Adds a loader and actions to fetch the recipient email property and the count of recipients missing it.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the wizard to request the missing recipient count from the backend, supporting the warning banner and review-step-only behavior.

observations.behavior: Adds a computed value and a banner component to display the missing recipient warning.
observations.posthog_connection: Renders a warning banner in the review step, potentially alerting users to missing recipient email configuration before sending.
